name: com.debyta/agent-check
title: DEBYTA Agent Check
description: Fraud check for AI agents before paying or sending crypto: signed allow/warn/block.

tools.name: create_intent
tools.description: Create a time-limited, signed authorization for an agent workflow. Provide explicit structured constraints; this tool does not infer permissions from natural-language instructions. Stateful use requires a DEBYTA key or an x402-paid call.

tools.name: create_intent_from_language
tools.description: Conservative German/English parser. Creates a signed intent only when amount, currency, merchant, payee, action and payment method are clear; otherwise returns clarification questions and creates nothing.

tools.name: register_merchant_payee
tools.description: Create a random DNS TXT challenge proving domain control for a declared merchant/payee association. Does not prove legal identity or bank-account ownership.

tools.name: verify_merchant_domain
tools.description: Check the DNS TXT challenge for a merchant verification ID.

tools.name: revoke_merchant_payee
tools.description: Revoke a previously DNS-verified merchant/payee association owned by the current API account.

tools.name: create_guarded_payment
tools.description: Create a payment record with a unique idempotency key. This does not move money. Requires a signed intent and a configured PSP adapter for authorization/execution.

tools.name: authorize_guarded_payment
tools.description: Rechecks the signed intent and server-side merchant/payee verification before requesting PSP authorization. Fails closed when verification or PSP adapter is missing.

tools.name: hold_guarded_payment
tools.description: Place a pending/authorized payment on DEBYTA hold and open a case requiring evidence. A provider hold is reported only when the PSP adapter confirms it.

tools.name: execute_guarded_payment
tools.description: Calls the configured PSP adapter only when the payment is authorized and no open hold or confirmed-fraud case exists. Returns blocked when a dispute is active.

tools.name: submit_payment_evidence
tools.description: Submit structured evidence metadata for an open payment dispute. Binary files should be uploaded through the authenticated REST evidence endpoint.

tools.name: get_payment_dispute
tools.description: Retrieve a payment dispute, evidence metadata and event history owned by the same API account.

tools.name: check_intent_action
tools.description: Call BEFORE executing an action. Checks action, amount, currency, merchant, recipient and payment method against a signed intent. block = do not execute; warn = pause for human approval; allow = constraints match, not a safety guarantee. The caller must enforce the decision. Requires a unique idempotencyKey.

tools.name: get_intent
tools.description: Retrieve the signed intent and current status. Requires the same DEBYTA key or x402 payer scope that created it.

tools.name: intent_events
tools.description: List recorded action checks for an intent.

tools.name: revoke_intent
tools.description: Immediately revoke an active intent so further new actions cannot be authorized.

tools.name: guard_payment
tools.description: One call BEFORE any payment or deposit. Pass whatever you have: crypto address (to, optional payee domain), signed payment request (request), an x402 402 response (requirements, maxAmount), a trading/investment platform (platform), or a shop URL / IBAN / payment link / e-mail / phone. DEBYTA runs every relevant check and returns ONE signed allow / warn / block with reasons. Price scales with the amount (0.02 %, capped).

tools.name: check_before_payment
tools.description: Call this BEFORE an agent pays, buys from a shop, transfers money to an IBAN or crypto address, or enters credentials on a website. Returns decision allow / warn / block with reasons, risk 0-100 and an Ed25519-signed verdict. allow = no known fraud indicators (not a guarantee); warn = ask the human; block = do not execute.

context.description: Message or page text that asked for the payment (not stored)

deep.description: Open the URL now and inspect it live (costs more)

tools.name: check_crypto_transfer
tools.description: Call this BEFORE sending any crypto (BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, SOL, TRX …). Detects mistyped or corrupted addresses (checksum), burn addresses, swapped addresses (payee verification: pass the recipient domain as "payee"), sanctioned addresses (OFAC), addresses linked to scam websites, address poisoning (look-alike of an address the user knows – pass them in "known"), wrong network for the asset, and scam patterns in the payment request. Returns signed allow / warn / block. Crypto transfers cannot be reversed: block = do not send.

chain.description: Network, e.g. bitcoin, ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon, bsc, tron, solana

known.description: Addresses the user already uses (address book, recent recipients) – compared in memory only, not stored

source.description: Website or link where the address came from

context.description: Message that asked for the transfer (not stored)

ref.description: Your own transfer id, signed into the verdict

payee.description: Domain of the intended recipient (e.g. the shop). Verifies the address against addresses the domain publishes itself; a swapped address is blocked

tools.name: check_x402_payment
tools.description: Call this when an HTTP request returns 402 Payment Required (x402) and BEFORE your wallet signs. Pass the 402 response body (or the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header) unchanged. DEBYTA verifies that payTo is published by the seller domain (payee verification), enforces your maxAmount (USD), and checks checksum, sanctions (OFAC) and fraud traces. Returns a signed allow / warn / block for the safest payment option.

requirements.description: 402 response body (object or JSON string) or the base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header

resource.description: URL you requested (if not inside the 402 body)

maxAmount.description: Your spending limit for this payment in USD

callback.description: HTTPS URL – DEBYTA POSTs a signed notice if this allow decision is revised later (address reported/sanctioned)

tools.name: check_crypto_platform
tools.description: Call this BEFORE depositing on any crypto trading, investment, mining or staking platform the user was referred to (often via chat, dating or social media). DEBYTA opens the site live and checks domain age, guaranteed returns, withdrawal "taxes"/fees, VIP tiers, licence claims, messenger-only support, exchange impersonation and the deposit addresses shown. Returns signed allow / warn / block with reasons.

context.description: Message that referred the user (not stored)

tools.name: verify_payment_request
tools.description: Call this when you received a DEBYTA payment request ("dpr1.…" or "debyta:pay?r=…") and BEFORE sending. DEBYTA checks the payee’s signature against the key published on the payee’s own domain – any swapped address, changed amount or expired request is detected – plus sanctions, checksum and fraud traces. Pass the address you are actually about to send to as "sendTo".

sendTo.description: Address you are actually about to send to

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Tell DEBYTA whether a checked payment turned out to be fraud or legitimate. Pass the "id" from the DEBYTA decision. Free. Two independent reports change the data; a single report never blocks anything.

tools.name: analyze_message
tools.description: Analyze an e-mail, SMS or chat message for scam patterns (18 patterns, 10 languages) and check every link, IBAN, crypto address and phone number in it. The text is not stored.
